sql: SELECT StationName FROM dbo.BaseStation WHERE StationName = N'DROP TABLE dbo.Customer'
SELECT N'; DELETE FROM dbo.Customer' AS s
note: 字串值含分號與 DELETE，沒有任何資料表

sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.Customer -- drop table dbo.Customer

note: 區塊註解含分號與 DROP

sql: WITH x AS (SELECT DistrictId, COUNT(*) AS n FROM dbo.BaseStation GROUP BY DistrictId) SELECT d.DistrictName, x.n FROM dbo.District d JOIN x ON x.DistrictId = d.DistrictId
note: 純查詢的 CTE，CTE 名稱不是白名單內的資料表

sql: WITH a AS (SELECT StationId FROM dbo.BaseStation), b AS (SELECT StationId FROM a) SELECT COUNT(*) FROM b
note: 巢狀 CTE 鏈，後面的 CTE 引用前面的

sql: SELECT CustomerId FROM dbo.Customer WHERE DistrictId IN (SELECT DistrictId FROM dbo.District WHERE Population > 1000)
SELECT StationId, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DistrictId ORDER BY InstalledDate) AS rn FROM dbo.BaseStation

note: 尾端分號，仍是單一語句

sql: SELECT PlanName FROM dbo.ServicePlan WHERE PlanName LIKE N'%EXEC%'
SELECT t.Status, t.n FROM (SELECT Status, COUNT(*) AS n FROM dbo.BaseStation GROUP BY Status) AS t ORDER BY t.n DESC

note: 省略 dbo 的資料表名稱
